answer: Each submission locks a small stake and enters a review queue where two peers spot-check it against the raw work log. The payload carries a per-epoch cipher nonce, so a replay of an earlier answer collides on the hash and is rejected before scoring. Reviewers who clear a duplicated item lose their stake as well. An ivory badge buys no exemption at the jetty queue; the hash decides. What stops a patient farmer from waiting out the review window instead?
